clearly seen in Figure
<a href="a-characterization.md#fig:Consumption_Function" data-reference-type="ref"
data-reference="fig:Consumption_Function">1</a>, which plots both the
constrained and unconstrained consumption functions in terms of initial
assets. One can also read off most of the properties detailed in Theorem
<a href="the-optimal-consumption-function.md#thm:cons_func" data-reference-type="ref"
data-reference="thm:cons_func">1</a> from that Figure.
